note: Per-athlete absolute-bpm training zones. Bands are inclusive on both edges and must be contiguous (each max_bpm + 1 == the next min_bpm); null means open-ended. 'grey' is the moderate-intensity rut the training model exists to eliminate, and it is deliberately kept separate from 'threshold' -- the %-of-max Z4 band lumps 166-186 together and cannot answer 'how much of that was actually threshold?'. Override the file location with HEALTH_ZONES_CONFIG.

zones.name: recovery
zones.description: Genuinely easy. Recovery jogs and warmup finish should land here.

zones.name: easy
zones.description: Aerobic base. Benchmark 5 km is held at 163-167.

zones.name: grey
zones.description: The moderate-intensity rut: too hard to recover from, too easy to drive adaptation. Time here is the number to drive down.

zones.name: threshold
zones.description: Steady-state threshold work. HR should flatten here, not ramp.

zones.name: vo2max
zones.description: VO2max intervals. Reps drifting up here are overcooked threshold reps.
